recommendations: As a breadwinner or with 2+ dependents, aim for 6-12 months of expenses in your emergency fund.
Consider extra debt payments to shorten term and reduce total interest.

Define 1-2 financial goals (e.g. emergency fund, house down payment) with target dates.
Revisit your budget and goals quarterly.
